welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Daily Travel
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your everyday mobility habits: the modes you use, how often you combine them, and which resources are available for your trips. Your answers help us understand daily travel patterns in the city. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. Your email address itself is never saved, and this questionnaire does not record your location.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

sections.title: Mobility habits
sections.description: Questions about how you typically get around on a day-to-day basis.

questions.text: Think of the trip you make most often in a typical week: in these questionnaires we call it your usual trip. What is its main purpose?

options.text: Accompanying or assisting someone (e.g. to school or medical visits)

questions.text: On average, how often do you make your usual trip?
On your usual trip, do you usually travel alone or with other people?

options.text: Accompanying children or people I look after
Accompanied by someone who helps me

questions.text: On your usual trip, which travel mode do you mainly use?
questions.help: Choose the mode you use for the longest part of the trip. Short walks to reach a stop or to change do not count.

options.text: On foot or in a wheelchair
Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bolt)

questions.text: At what times of day do you most often travel? (Select all that apply)

sections.title: Combining and sharing transport
sections.description: Questions about trips in which you change transport mode, and about shared vehicles.

questions.text: Which of these modes do you use together in the same trip at least once a week? Choose at least two.
questions.help: A combined trip is one where you change mode on the way.

options.text: Taxi or similar service (e.g. Uber, Bolt)

questions.text: What difficulties do you experience when combining different transport modes (e.g. bike + public transport, car + metro, walking + bus)?

options.text: Vehicles are too crowded (e.g. no space for a bicycle, pushchair or luggage)
Poor coordination between modes (long waiting times, missed connections)
Lack of infrastructure (e.g. no bicycle parking or no bicycle access on public transport)
Complicated transfers (stations far apart, unclear routes)
The stop or station is hard to reach on foot (no pavement, difficult crossings)
Cost is too high when combining modes
Services are infrequent or do not run in the evening
Physical effort is too high (e.g. carrying a bicycle or walking long distances)
Accessibility issues (stairs, no lifts, no space for a wheelchair)
I do not experience significant difficulties

questions.text: When you face these difficulties, how do you mostly respond?

options.text: I stop using one of the modes (e.g. stop bringing my bike)
I switch to a single mode (e.g. only car, only public transport)
I change the time of travel (e.g. avoid peak hours)
I change the route or transfer point
I choose a different combination of modes
I continue using the same combination despite difficulties
I reduce how often I make that trip
I look for alternative solutions (e.g. bike sharing instead of own bike)
I avoid that trip entirely if possible

questions.text: How often do you use shared mobility services (bike-share, e-scooter, car-share)?
questions.help: Shared mobility means vehicles you rent for a short time, usually through an app, such as bikes, e-scooters or cars.

options.text: I never use shared mobility services

sections.title: Preferences & Satisfaction
sections.description: Questions about what matters to you when choosing how to travel.

questions.text: Overall, how satisfied are you with the mode you mainly use for your usual trip?
Which aspects of this mode are you most dissatisfied with?

options.text: Reliability (the trip takes the time I expect)
Frequency of services and waiting times
Service in the evening and on public holidays

questions.text: When choosing how to travel, which factors matter most to you?

options.text: Mental well-being (how calm or stressed I feel)
Reliability (the trip takes the time I expect)
Being able to bring children, a pushchair or shopping

sections.title: Vehicles and apps
sections.description: Questions about the vehicles and tools available to you for travel.

questions.text: Which of the following vehicles are available in your household? (Count only vehicles used by adults.)

questions.text: Which of the following do you personally use regularly? (Select all that apply)
How easy is it for you to use a vehicle of your household when you need it?

options.text: I don't use it because I don't drive or can't drive it

questions.text: How comfortable are you using navigation or map apps for travel?
questions.help: Navigation apps show maps and directions, for example Google Maps or Moovit.

questions.text: How comfortable are you using apps to buy or validate public transport tickets?
How comfortable are you using apps to call a taxi or a car with driver (e.g. Uber) or to rent shared vehicles (bicycles, e-scooters, cars)?

welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Daily Travel
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your everyday mobility habits: the modes you use, how often you combine them, and which resources are available for your trips. Your answers help us understand daily travel patterns in the city. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

fr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur vos habitudes de déplacement au quotidien : les modes de transport que vous utilisez, la façon dont vous les combinez et les moyens dont vous disposez pour vos trajets. Vos réponses nous aident à mieux comprendre les déplacements quotidiens dans la ville. La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom : elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

de.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Dieser SmartUrbanity-Fragebogen befasst sich mit Ihren täglichen Mobilitätsgewohnheiten: Welche Verkehrsmittel Sie nutzen, wie oft Sie sie kombinieren und welche Möglichkeiten Ihnen für Ihre Wege zur Verfügung stehen. Ihre Antworten helfen uns, tägliche Mobilitätsmuster in der Stadt besser zu verstehen. Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft: Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf die verschiedenen SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können.

fa.#<p>Questions about what matters to you: سؤال‌هایی درباره چیزهایی که هنگام انتخاب روش سفر برای شما مهم است.

fa.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
این پرسشنامه SmartUrbanity درباره عادت‌های رفت‌وآمد روزانه شماست: چه روش‌هایی استفاده می‌کنید، چگونه آن‌ها را با هم ترکیب می‌کنید و چه امکاناتی برای سفرهای خود دارید. پاسخ‌های شما به ما کمک می‌کند الگوهای رفت‌وآمد روزانه در شهر را بهتر بفهمیم. شرکت در این پرسشنامه داوطلبانه است. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود: پاسخ‌ها با یک کد مستعار که از نشانی ایمیل شما ساخته می‌شود ذخیره می‌شوند تا پاسخ‌های شما به پرسشنامه‌های مختلف SmartUrbanity بتوانند با هم تحلیل شوند.

hu.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Ez a SmartUrbanity kérdőív a mindennapi közlekedési szokásairól szól: milyen közlekedési módokat használ, hogyan kombinálja őket, és milyen lehetőségek állnak rendelkezésére. Válaszai nem kapcsolódnak a nevéhez: egy, az e-mail-címéből képzett álnevesített kóddal tároljuk őket, hogy a különböző SmartUrbanity-kérdőívekre adott válaszait együtt lehessen elemezni.

This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your everyday mobility habits: the modes you use, how often you combine them, and which resources are available for your trips. Your answers help us understand daily travel patterns in the city. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. Your email address itself is never saved, and this questionnaire does not record your location.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur vos habitudes de déplacement au quotidien : les modes de transport que vous utilisez, la façon dont vous les combinez et les moyens dont vous disposez pour vos trajets. Vos réponses nous aident à mieux comprendre les déplacements quotidiens dans la ville. La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom : elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble. Votre adresse e-mail elle-même n’est jamais enregistrée et ce questionnaire n’enregistre pas votre position.

This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your everyday mobility habits: the modes you use, how often you combine them, and which resources are available for your trips. Your answers help us understand daily travel patterns in the city. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. Your email address itself is never saved, and this questionnaire does not record your location.

welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your everyday mobility habits: the modes you use, how often you combine them, and which resources are available for your trips. Your answers help us understand daily travel patterns in the city. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. Your email address itself is never saved, and this questionnaire does not record your location.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

en.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your everyday mobility habits: the modes you use, how often you combine them, and which resources are available for your trips. Your answers help us understand daily travel patterns in the city. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. Your email address itself is never saved, and this questionnaire does not record your location.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

it.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Questo questionario SmartUrbanity si concentra sulle tue abitudini quotidiane di mobilità: i mezzi che utilizzi, la frequenza con cui li combini e le risorse disponibili per i tuoi spostamenti. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a comprendere i modelli di mobilità quotidiana in città. La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme. Il tuo indirizzo email non viene mai salvato e questo questionario non registra la tua posizione.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur vos habitudes de déplacement au quotidien : les modes de transport que vous utilisez, la façon dont vous les combinez et les moyens dont vous disposez pour vos trajets. Vos réponses nous aident à mieux comprendre les déplacements quotidiens dans la ville. La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom : elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble. Votre adresse e-mail elle-même n’est jamais enregistrée et ce questionnaire n’enregistre pas votre position.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

de.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Dieser SmartUrbanity-Fragebogen befasst sich mit Ihren täglichen Mobilitätsgewohnheiten: Welche Verkehrsmittel Sie nutzen, wie oft Sie sie kombinieren und welche Möglichkeiten Ihnen für Ihre Wege zur Verfügung stehen. Ihre Antworten helfen uns, tägliche Mobilitätsmuster in der Stadt besser zu verstehen. Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft: Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf die verschiedenen SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können. Ihre E-Mail-Adresse selbst wird nie gespeichert, und dieser Fragebogen erfasst Ihren Standort nicht.

de.#<p>Questions about trips in which you c: Fragen zu Wegen, auf denen Sie das Verkehrsmittel wechseln, und zu geteilten Fahrzeugen.
de.#Which of these modes do you use togethe: Welche dieser Verkehrsmittel kombinieren Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche auf demselben Weg? Wählen Sie mindestens zwei aus.
de.#Being able to bring children, a pushcha: Kinder, Kinderwagen oder Einkäufe mitnehmen können
de.#Which of the following vehicles are ava: Welche der folgenden Fahrzeuge stehen in Ihrem Haushalt zur Verfügung? (Zählen Sie nur Fahrzeuge, die von Erwachsenen genutzt werden.)

tr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
Bu SmartUrbanity anketi günlük ulaşım alışkanlıklarınızla ilgilidir: hangi ulaşım seçeneklerini kullandığınız, bunları ne sıklıkta birleştirdiğiniz ve yolculuklarınız için hangi imkânlara sahip olduğunuz. Yanıtlarınız şehirdeki günlük yolculuk düzenlerini anlamamıza yardımcı olur. Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez: farklı SmartUrbanity anketlerine verdiğiniz yanıtların birlikte analiz edilebilmesi için e-posta adresinizden türetilen takma adlı bir kodla saklanır. en.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire foc:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire focuses on your everyday mobility habits: the modes you use, how often you combine them, and which resources are available for your trips. Your answers help us understand daily travel patterns in the city. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together. Your email address itself is never saved, and this questionnaire does not record your location.
